title: Meet The 3D Artist Spotted By Sm Entertainment – Here'S How He Works!
description:
🎬 From Digital Threads to Artistic Worlds
Meet Jinbeom Park, how he is redefining the digital fashion space — one polygon at a time.

Known for a distinct visual style and a boundary-pushing approach to creation,
he’s collaborated with top brands across fashion, entertainment, and digital art.
And at the center of it all? Marvelous Designer.

In this interview, he shares how he uses 3D garments not just as clothing,
but as a canvas — building immersive worlds, stories, and identities.

💡 Get inspired by how one artist turns digital fabric into a powerful form of self-expression — and carves out a bold creative space of his own.
